protocol: 5 folds by speaker. Each fold tests on one block of speakers, uses 9 speakers from the next block to choose the epoch or C, the calibration temperature and the decision threshold, and trains on the rest. 'summary' is raw (threshold 0.5, uncalibrated); 'summary_calibrated' uses the validation temperature and threshold. Values are mean and standard deviation over the test folds.

egemaps.model: eGeMAPS v02 functionals + logistic regression (balanced class weights)

wavlm.model: microsoft/wavlm-base-plus (frozen), learned layer weights, attentive pooling, 4-class head
wavlm.head: four-attentive

wavlm/binary-mean.model: microsoft/wavlm-base-plus (frozen), learned layer weights, mean pooling, 2-class head
wavlm/binary-mean.head: binary-mean
